applications.title: ICH Radar
applications.description: AI-assisted cultural intelligence engine that autonomously scans blogs, local news, and community forums to discover, document, and analyze Intangible Cultural Heritage using Google Gemini with Search grounding.

applications.title: GSI Radar
applications.description: AI-powered intelligence system that transforms decentralised innovation data into structured, policy-ready insights and identifies patterns, emerging risks, and high-impact opportunities across sectors.

applications.title: Horizon Scanning
applications.description: Interactive scanning matrices with AI-powered strategic synthesis to explore probability, impact, uncertainty, and time-horizon relationships for foresight practice.

applications.title: PesisirKita
applications.description: An offline-first field-operation and mapping app empowering youth to conduct coastal ecological mapping and compile field data into a PDF portfolio.

applications.title: ImpactArchitect v3.3
applications.description: A digital canvas integrating Theory of Change with the COM-B behavioural model, enhanced with Gemini AI as a strategic sparring partner.

applications.title: Foodways: Shared Heritage
applications.description: Serverless GIS platform mapping culinary history networks with polygon mapping and node-link network analysis, built with Vanilla JS, Tailwind, Leaflet.js, and Google Sheets.

applications.title: GlobalScript
applications.description: A freehand writing app supporting global and indigenous scripts, including Latin, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Javanese, Balinese, and more.

applications.title: Artifact Radar
applications.description: AI-assisted OSINT monitoring system combining web crawling, search-engine intelligence, and AI reasoning to detect and analyze online trade in ancient artifacts and cultural heritage objects.

applications.title: DRR Builder's Journey
applications.description: Educational block-building game where players construct bridges, seawalls, and evacuation paths to protect communities from floods, tsunamis, and volcanic threats.

applications.title: BATNA Analyzer
applications.description: Decision-support tool for structured negotiation, helping users map alternatives, compare outcomes, and assess leverage using evidence-based strategy.

applications.title: Variable Planner
applications.description: A serverless, browser-based canvas for dynamic scenario planning and organising variables and decision pathways.

applications.title: Leader's Compass
applications.description: An AI-powered diagnostic platform that transforms informal observations into actionable job-enrichment strategies and helps leaders optimise team engagement.

applications.title: Atlas of Atmosphere
applications.description: Evidence-based environmental design app translating research into actionable atmosphere recipes for lighting, temperature, colour, and sensory elements.

applications.title: S3 Builder
applications.description: Quantitative intelligence platform integrating Indonesia's PODES logic with Gemini AI for Smart Specialization Strategy analysis and report generation.

applications.title: GIS MEL: Citizenship Data
applications.description: Serverless GIS-based monitoring dashboard visualising biodiversity and biosphere-reserve overlaps on an interactive map with CRUD operations.

applications.title: Script Explorer
applications.description: Interactive map visualising digital preservation status and geographic distribution of more than 60 global and indigenous writing systems.

applications.title: Barnum Effect Demonstrator
applications.description: Interactive psychology tool illustrating cognitive bias by demonstrating how people may accept vague, general statements as highly personal.

applications.title: Gamified Learning Architect
applications.description: 3D interactive educational platforms using WebGL and Three.js to gamify complex policy concepts, including ICH safeguarding and climate resilience.

applications.title: E-Persuratan
applications.description: Bilingual serverless government mail-management system with CRUD workflows and analytics using Google Sheets and Apps Script.

applications.title: StructureFlow
applications.description: AI-assisted writing framework prioritising structure before content, with section guidance, drafting support, and feedback.

applications.title: SQL & NoSQL Academy
applications.description: Browser-based gamified platform for learning SQL and NoSQL with client-side query processing, real-time results, bilingual support, and level-based progression.

applications.title: Gamified HTML/JS Learning
applications.description: Two 90-level gamified learning experiences for HTML/CSS and JavaScript with live browser rendering, AI guidance, guided and sandbox modes, and exportable standalone HTML.

applications.title: Smart OCR AI
applications.description: Multi-agent OCR system combining local Tesseract processing with Gemini Vision for complex layouts, tables, and charts from images and PDFs.

applications.title: UN Travel Calculator
applications.description: Automates UN subsistence allowance calculations, including ICSC rates and deductions, to support administrative efficiency and audit compliance.

applications.title: ShadowOps (ISO)
applications.description: Strategic operations map and activity tracker combining pipeline visibility, daily logs, and AI-generated summaries via Google Sheets and Apps Script.

applications.title: Bayesian Tools
applications.description: Probabilistic reasoning tools using a Naive Bayes framework to evaluate hypotheses with likelihood ratios and structured evidence.

applications.title: Learner ID Tool
applications.description: Behavioural-science-based app using 18 questions to identify instructional friction and provide actionable guidance for educators and trainers.

applications.title: Misc / Prototypes
applications.description: Experimental setups and utilities including a 3D Museum demonstration, WebPDF browser utility, and prototyping environments.

applications.title: Invergent
applications.description: Experimental browser-based toolkit for practicing divergent and convergent thinking. Combines possibility generation, constraint-based evaluation, trade-off analysis, switching exercises, heuristic profiles, and timed learning sessions. Questions and exercises are editable through a JSON question bank.

applications.title: DKV Colour
applications.description: Interactive visual design and colour-theory exploration tool for experimenting with colour relationships, contrast, and composition in a lightweight browser-based workspace.

applications.title: MyGrammar
applications.description: Browser-based English grammar and writing toolkit combining live grammar correction, verb and tense exploration, Indonesian learner-error patterns, and document checking for grammar, verb patterns, spelling, sentence health, and writing style. Uses editable JSON knowledge bases and offline-capable tools.

applications.title: MyJOBS
applications.description: Experimental job aggregator designed to help users in Indonesia and ASEAN discover international, humanitarian, development, UN, and NGO opportunities. Combines multi-source vacancy aggregation, location-aware filtering, UN professional-level and UNDP IPSA classification, source and country filters, search, saved opportunities, and links to original vacancies. Some vacancies may be missed or misclassified.

applications.title: Global Product Intelligence Radar (GPIR)
applications.description: Multilingual platform for pre-baseline mapping of local economic development, SMEs, and creative economy. Local SME Finder explores opportunities based on resources, skills, and capital; Potential Explorer maps locations, tourism attractions, heritage sites, and global market signals using sources such as OpenStreetMap, OpenTripMap, UNESCO DataHub, UN Tourism, World Bank, Wikivoyage, and UN Comtrade.

applications.title: World Heritage Atlas
applications.description: Interactive modular web application connecting UNESCO-designated sites worldwide through geospatial exploration, 3D terrain visualisation, building models, and educational quizzes. Integrates UNESCO DataHub, biodiversity observations, environmental data, and news signals to connect cultural and natural heritage with broader environmental and social context.

applications.title: SekolahKita
applications.description: Education-related web application listed in the portfolio links. Further feature description has not yet been verified.

applications.title: Smart MoM Studio
applications.description: Privacy-first, offline-capable meeting assistant combining multiple physical microphones with system audio through the Web Audio API and using Gemini AI to generate structured meeting minutes. Raw audio is kept in local storage, with online and offline transcription workflows.

applications.title: Pocket Science Lab (Science-HUB)
applications.description: Modular, offline-capable STEM application that turns smartphones into interactive science instruments using device sensors, simulations, and DIY crafting guides for hands-on exploration.

applications.title: Stakeholder Intelligence Platform
applications.description: Decision-support prototype for stakeholder mapping that combines influence analysis, salience assessment, engagement prioritisation, and network visualisation.

applications.title: IBF System
applications.description: Climate-risk monitoring and anticipatory-action platform integrating satellite telemetry, weather forecasts, and community vulnerability data to produce impact-based risk assessments and early actions for agriculture and food security.

applications.title: OurHeritage EWS
applications.description: Serverless early-warning system for museums and historical sites. Tracks environmental threats such as extreme humidity, earthquakes, and air pollution, calculates artefact risk scores, provides preventive-conservation checklists, and stores local risk history for up to five years.

applications.title: GiziKita
applications.description: Offline decision-support application helping families and community health workers plan affordable, nutritionally balanced meals using local food prices and evidence-based recommendations.

applications.title: EDU Radar
applications.description: AI-assisted OSINT platform for discovering, analysing, and structuring educational innovations worldwide. Integrates Google Scholar and UNESCO UNESDOC to help identify trends and opportunities in educational transformation.

applications.title: Nexus Radar
applications.description: AI-powered OSINT engine designed to detect emerging environmental and societal anomalies and weak signals across climate, oceans, and biodiversity for proactive disaster-risk-reduction intelligence.

applications.title: Academic Credential Conversion
applications.description: Multi-stage AI workflow for international academic credential conversion.
